events.name: order.created
events.description: Fires when a new order is placed in the demo store. Optionally filter by currency, or to high-value orders (a total of 100 or more).

currency.description: Only deliver orders in this currency.

highValue.description: true for orders with a total of 100 or more, false for the rest.

total.description: Order total in major units, for example 129.99

highValue.description: true when total is 100 or more
